The first-week course from docs/product/launch-brief.md ("First week: World foundations"), as the path on Home. Units and nodes only: every country name, flag, place and capital comes from the geography packs, and every word a learner reads is an i18n key in packages/i18n/locales/*/course.json. Node ids ship in save data as the keys finished lessons are counted under, so they are permanent; a later version may add, reorder or retune nodes, never rename one.

One node per day of the brief, and one deliberate difference from its table: day 1 practises the flags of all six countries days 2 and 3 use (SE, NO, US, JP, BR, KE), not only the first four. Each fact is asked at most once per lesson, and the D1 Worker refuses a focused lesson under five questions (FOCUS_TOO_NARROW, the engines' MIN_LESSON_ITEMS), so four flags would open the path on an empty lesson for every learner on the release backend. Moving BR and KE forward a day also closes a gap in the table itself: day 6 mixes the flags of all twelve and never introduced those two. `pnpm content:validate` composes every node with the real engine and fails any that cannot fill a lesson with and without a screen reader, so this cannot regress silently.

The brief's day 7 is "after a delay"; this version has no time gate, so the check opens when day 6 is done and relies on the composer serving due work first. Days are not a scheduler (the brief says so): a node opens when the one before it has its finished lessons. Awaiting native-speaker editorial approval (L18) like the rest of the course copy.
